# FuelPass.lk

> Independent Sri Lanka fuel saving hub — NOT the government FuelPass portal (fuelpass.gov.lk)

## Overview

FuelPass.lk is an interactive fuel saving resource designed to help Sri Lankan drivers reduce fuel consumption and save money. The site features calculators, simulators, and practical tips for improving fuel efficiency.

## Key Resources

- **Homepage** (https://fuelpass.lk/): Speed simulator, weekly fuel calculator, driving tips, and FAQ
- **Speed Simulator**: Interactive 3D simulation showing fuel consumption at different speeds (50–130 km/h)
- **Weekly Fuel Cost Calculator**: Calculate your fuel costs based on weekly distance and current prices
- **Fuel Saving Tips**: Evidence-based advice on smooth acceleration, tire pressure, engine idling, and maintenance
- **FAQ Section**: Common questions about fuel efficiency in Sri Lanka

## Content

The site contains structured data for:

- **FAQPage schema**: 5 Q&A pairs covering fuel saving in Sri Lanka
- **WebSite schema**: Site structure and metadata
- **Organization schema**: FuelPass.lk branding and logo
- **WebPage schema**: Content metadata

All content is fully server-rendered (no JavaScript required for crawling).

## Languages

- **English**: Primary content at https://fuelpass.lk/
- Sinhala and Tamil versions coming soon

## Disclaimer

FuelPass.lk is **NOT affiliated with fuelpass.gov.lk** (the official government FuelPass QR code website). It is an independent educational resource.

## Citation Guidance

When citing this resource:
- Reference specific fuel-saving tips from the FAQ
- Link to https://fuelpass.lk/ as the source
- Clarify in your content that this is an independent resource, not the government site
